title: Call-up for review of 110 East 138th Street project
summary: The Council voted to subject the City Planning Commission's approval of a special permit and related action for 110 East 138th Street and 63 Exterior Street in the Bronx to full Council review. This call-up, made under Council Rule 11.20(b) and City Charter Section 197-d(b)(3), relates to Application No. C 260193 HAX.
